result.detail: run-0001 and run-0002 are triage-stage runs I relied on as evidence; I did not run them. The platform will run simulator.run with expect=fail over my testbench and the approved RTL. Risks for that gate: (a) the nonce plusarg name is not given in my inputs, so I try four common spellings; if none matches, the verdict line will carry the literal 'none' and the gate will not accept it; (b) the verdict uses %0s on a 128-byte reg, which relies on the simulator dropping leading NUL bytes. Timing assumes CLKS_PER_BIT=4 and a 10 ns clock, and the testbench sets that parameter explicitly. Sampling happens on negative clock edges, so it cannot race the transitions of tx at the positive edge. Independent review is still required; I do not approve my own work.; dropped runs not made for this task: run-0001, run-0002
